# Luna-12N - Temporal Direction and Intrinsic-Decay-Gated Shortcut Verification

Read the architecture contract, changelog, acceptance criteria, Luna workflow,
handoff template, corrected Luna-12H through Luna-12M specifications and
handoffs, and the Luna-0 12M review before implementation. Record the exact
baseline revision and preserve unrelated worktree changes.

This is creation-only until Luna-0 gives an explicit execution assignment. Own
only the bounded experiment, its legal policy exposure, 12M-based measurement,
focused tests, machine-readable artifacts and handoff. Use the existing
Luna-12E routed topology, bounded plasticity authority and corrected Luna-12M
`TPCN-EDGE-2` observer. Do not replace measured route traffic with constants.

Compare current direction/no decay gating, reversed legal orientation/no gating,
current direction with intrinsic-decay-relative preference, reversed direction
with decay-relative preference, random legal growth, and fixed topology. Keep
candidate exposure, attempts, bounds, workloads and seeds matched. Use seeds
`0, 1, 2, 3, 4` unless a predeclared repository reason changes them.

Decay-aware evidence may use only local timestamps, elapsed time, the source
neuron's decay parameter/residual state, local candidate evidence and legal
local edge state. For the exponential reference, a quantity equivalent to
`D = exp(-lambda * delta_t)` is permitted. Do not add a permanent threshold,
protected edge, persistent edge strength/utility/eligibility, pruning change,
global shortest-path input, label input, classifier objective or genetic/local
micro-network mechanism.

Separate static shortcut yield from used shortcut yield. A used shortcut must
both reduce measured cumulative causal delay (also record hop and arrival-time
deltas) and carry observed routed traffic. Require before/after/removal causal
intervention, route competition measurements, deterministic replay, equal
opportunity checks, label/global-topology leakage checks, unequal-delay handling,
and comparable prediction/error and proxy-energy metrics.

Report `OBSERVED`, `INFERRED` and `HYPOTHESIZED` separately. Return every
result to Luna-0. Do not promote A14, authorize a successor Luna, or claim
hardware acceptance.
